# Brian Cline

> Brian Cline is a US Sailing certified instructor, former high-speed ferry captain, and marine services professional based in Berkeley, California. He provides hull cleaning, boat detailing, vessel deliveries, and private sailing instruction on San Francisco Bay. Nearly 20 years of experience teaching and working on the water.

## Marine Services

- [Marine Services Overview](https://briancline.co/marine): Hub page for all marine services offered by Brian Cline on San Francisco Bay.
- [Hull Cleaning](https://briancline.co/hull-cleaning): Brian Cline Diving and Hull Cleaning (Sailor Skills, LLC), (415) 529-0272. Professional underwater hull cleaning for sailboats and powerboats at Berkeley Marina, California. Currently serving Berkeley Marina only; referrals offered for boats at other Bay Area marinas. Recurring plans from $4.50/ft and one-time service. Includes anode inspection, running gear inspection, and before/after video. The page has an instant estimator and a "How pricing works" section.
- [Hull cleaning cost at Berkeley Marina](https://briancline.co/hull-cleaning/cost): Answers "how much does it cost to have a diver clean my hull in Berkeley": $4.50/ft recurring, $6.00/ft one-time, $150 minimum per visit, a price table by boat length and type, surcharges, and FAQ.
- [Hull cleaning rate card (JSON)](https://briancline.co/pricing/hull-cleaning.json): Every rate, surcharge, the growth matrix, the minimum charge and the current offer, generated from the same code as the estimator.
- [Hull cleaning quote API](https://briancline.co/api/hull-cleaning-quote?service=cleaning&length=35&frequency=monthly): Read-only GET endpoint that returns the same estimate as the page, with line items, a range across growth conditions, and a prefilled order link. Parameters are documented in the rate card JSON. Estimates only; nothing is booked or charged.
- [Boat Detailing](https://briancline.co/boat-detailing): Above-waterline boat cleaning, waxing, polishing, metal polishing, teak care, and interior detailing throughout San Francisco Bay. Serving Berkeley, Emeryville, Richmond, and Oakland marinas.
- [Vessel Deliveries](https://briancline.co/deliveries): Coastal and offshore vessel delivery services along the US West Coast and beyond, captained personally by a former high-speed ferry captain.

## Sailing Instruction

- [Sailing Lessons](https://briancline.co/sailing-lessons): Private and small-group sailing instruction on San Francisco Bay. US Sailing certified. Beginner through advanced offshore passage making. Nearly 20 years of teaching experience.
- [Sailing Lessons FAQ](https://briancline.co/sailing-lessons/faq): Rates, cancellation policies, insurance requirements, and packages for private sailing lessons.

## About

- [Brian Cline](https://briancline.co): Personal portfolio site. Entrepreneur, builder, US Sailing instructor, former high-speed ferry captain. Solo sailed to Hawaii and back. Thru-hiked 1,000+ miles of the Appalachian Trail.
